import copy,json
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from easydict import EasyDict
from .common import O,S,write,sha
from libero.libero.benchmark import get_benchmark
from libero.lifelong.datasets import get_dataset,SequenceVLDataset
from libero.lifelong.utils import get_task_embs,control_seed,torch_load_model
from libero.lifelong.models.complete_policy import CompletePolicy
from libero.lifelong.models.brief import BriefPolicy

def cfg(name):
    from .common import SEED
    c=EasyDict(json.loads((O/f'resolved_{name}.json').read_text()))
    assert c.benchmark_name=='LIBERO_OBJECT' and c.gamma==.3 and c.pretrain.endswith('object_multitask_model_ep99.pth')
    assert c.seed==SEED and all(c.policy[k] is True for k in ('use_vision','use_language','use_state'))
    return c
def data_setup(c,all_datasets=False):
    b=get_benchmark(c.benchmark_name)(c.data.task_order_index)
    datasets=[];shape=None
    # Same dataset and tokenization order as released exporter/evaluator.
    for t in range(10 if all_datasets else 1):
        d,shape=get_dataset(str(__import__('pathlib').Path(c.folder)/b.get_task_demonstration(t)),
            c.data.obs.modality,initialize_obs_utils=(t==0),seq_len=8,demo_limit=10,train=c.training)
        datasets.append(d)
    embs=get_task_embs(c,[b.get_task(t).language for t in range(10)]);b.set_task_embs(embs)
    return b,[SequenceVLDataset(d,embs['input_ids'][t],embs['attention_mask'][t]) for t,d in enumerate(datasets)],shape
def strict_downstream(model,path):
    sd=torch_load_model(path)[0];target=model.state_dict()
    wanted={k:v for k,v in sd.items() if k.startswith(('temporal_transformer.','policy_head.'))}
    expected={k for k in target if k.startswith(('temporal_transformer.','policy_head.'))}
    assert set(wanted)==expected,'Incomplete downstream checkpoint'
    for k in expected:assert target[k].shape==wanted[k].shape,k
    result=model.load_state_dict(wanted,strict=False)
    assert not result.unexpected_keys and not (set(result.missing_keys)&expected)
    for k in expected:assert torch.equal(model.state_dict()[k].cpu(),wanted[k].cpu()),k
    return len(expected)
def complete(c,shape):
    p=CompletePolicy(c,shape).cuda() # Native constructor strict=True on full official weight.
    raw=torch_load_model(c.pretrain)[0];actual=p.state_dict()
    assert set(raw)==set(actual)
    for k in raw:assert torch.equal(raw[k].cpu(),actual[k].cpu()),k
    return p
def angular_mean(global_current,own_reference,old_references,gamma):
    if not old_references:return global_current.sum()*0
    g=F.normalize(global_current,dim=-1,eps=1e-8)
    own=F.normalize(own_reference,dim=-1,eps=1e-8)
    theta_pos=torch.acos((g*own).sum(-1).clamp(-1+1e-6,1-1e-6))
    losses=[]
    for ref in old_references:
        old=F.normalize(ref,dim=-1,eps=1e-8)
        neg=torch.acos((g*old).sum(-1).clamp(-1+1e-6,1-1e-6))
        phi=torch.acos((own*old).sum(-1).clamp(-1+1e-6,1-1e-6))
        losses.append(torch.relu(theta_pos-neg+gamma*phi).mean())
    return torch.stack(losses).mean()

from .common import SEED,SELECTOR_SEED
import argparse,copy,json,os,time,csv,hashlib,pickle
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.distributed as dist
from torch.nn.parallel import DistributedDataParallel as DDP
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader,DistributedSampler
from .common import O,write,save,sha,verify,rng,restore_rng,hashes,jsonable
from .model import cfg,angular_mean,strict_downstream
from ra_exp.storage import store
from libero.lifelong.algos.mlr import MLR,build_dataset_for_task,build_ifa_similarity_matrix
from libero.lifelong.utils import control_seed,get_task_embs
from libero.libero.benchmark import get_benchmark

def cpu(x):
    if torch.is_tensor(x):return x.detach().cpu().clone()
    if isinstance(x,dict):return {k:cpu(v) for k,v in x.items()}
    if isinstance(x,list):return [cpu(v) for v in x]
    if isinstance(x,tuple):return tuple(cpu(v) for v in x)
    return copy.deepcopy(x)
def references(c,t):
    out={};maxdev={}
    for task in range(6,t+1):
        files=sorted((O/'features'/str(t)).glob('*.pt')) if task==t else sorted(Path(c.buffer_dir).glob(f't{task}__*.pt'))
        assert files;ref=None;dev=0.
        for p in files:
            v=torch.load(p,map_location='cpu')['feature'][0,:,0,:]
            if ref is None:ref=v[0].clone()
            dev=max(dev,float((v-ref).abs().max()))
        assert dev<1e-4,('Non-stable language references: protocol decision needed',task,dev)
        out[task]=ref.cuda();maxdev[task]=dev
    return out,maxdev
class PaperMLR(MLR):
    def observe(self,data,current_task_id,epoch,ifa_info=None):
        data[0]=self.map_tensor_to_device(data[0]);self.optimizer.zero_grad()
        bc,last=self.policy.module.compute_loss(data[0],None,None)
        mask=torch.tensor([int(x)==current_task_id for x in data[1]],device=last.device)
        pairs=ifa_info['selected_pairs'];olds=[self.refs[j if k==current_task_id else k] for j,k in pairs]
        extra=angular_mean(last[mask],self.refs[current_task_id],olds,self.cfg.gamma) if mask.any() else last.sum()*0
        loss=bc+.1*extra;assert torch.isfinite(loss)
        (self.loss_scale*loss).backward()
        if self.cfg.train.grad_clip is not None:torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.policy.parameters(),self.cfg.train.grad_clip)
        self.optimizer.step();self.scheduler.step()
        self.step+=1;return float(loss.detach())
def build(c):
    control_seed(SEED);b=get_benchmark('LIBERO_OBJECT')(0)
    b.set_task_embs(get_task_embs(c,[b.get_task(i).language for i in range(10)]))
    Path(c.experiment_dir).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);Path(c.buffer_dir).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    a=PaperMLR(1,c).cuda();n=strict_downstream(a.policy,c.pretrain)
    assert all(n.startswith(('temporal_transformer.','policy_head.')) for n,p in a.policy.named_parameters() if p.requires_grad)
    a.policy=DDP(a.policy,device_ids=[0],output_device=0);a.train();a.step=0
    return a,b
def capture(a):
    return dict(model=cpu(a.policy.state_dict()),optimizer=cpu(a.optimizer.state_dict()),scheduler=cpu(a.scheduler.state_dict()),
        grads={n:cpu(p.grad) if p.grad is not None else None for n,p in a.policy.named_parameters()},
        modes={n:m.training for n,m in a.policy.named_modules()},rng=cpu(rng()),step=a.step)
def restore(a,x):
    a.policy.load_state_dict(x['model'],strict=True);a.optimizer.load_state_dict(x['optimizer']);a.scheduler.load_state_dict(x['scheduler']);a.step=x['step']
    for n,p in a.policy.named_parameters():p.grad=None if x['grads'][n] is None else x['grads'][n].to(p.device)
    for n,m in a.policy.named_modules():m.training=x['modes'][n]
    restore_rng(x['rng'])
def checkpoint(a,root,t,epoch,complete=False):
    save(root/'recovery/latest.pth',dict(state=capture(a),task=t,next_epoch=epoch,stage_complete=complete,
        contract_sha256=sha(O/'CONTRACT.json'),modal_sha256=sha(O/'MODAL_CONTRACT.json'),buffer_hashes=hashes(Path(a.cfg.buffer_dir))))
def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('arm',choices=['ra_coreset']);ap.add_argument('--resume',action='store_true');args=ap.parse_args()
    verify();assert json.loads((O/'GPU_PREFLIGHT.json').read_text())['status']=='PASS'
    assert (O/'FEATURES.json').is_file();c=cfg(args.arm);root=Path(c.run_root)
    assert not (root/'TRAINING_COMPLETE.json').exists(),'Already complete'
    cp=root/'recovery/latest.pth';assert args.resume or not cp.exists(),'Explicit resume required'
    resumed=torch.load(cp,map_location='cpu') if args.resume else None
    dist.init_process_group('nccl');torch.cuda.set_device(0);begin=time.time()
    try:
        a,b=build(c);history=[]
        if not resumed:
            r=rng()
            digest={k:hashlib.sha256(pickle.dumps(v) if k in ('python','numpy') else b''.join(x.cpu().numpy().tobytes() for x in (v if isinstance(v,list) else [v]))).hexdigest() for k,v in r.items()}
            model_digest={k:hashlib.sha256(v.detach().cpu().numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest() for k,v in a.policy.state_dict().items()}
            evidence=dict(rng=digest,tensors=model_digest)
            write(root/'INITIAL_STATE.json',evidence)
            assert evidence==json.loads((Path(os.environ['RA_PARENT'])/'coreset/INITIAL_STATE.json').read_text()),'Initialization differs from parent'
        if resumed:
            assert resumed['contract_sha256']==sha(O/'CONTRACT.json') and resumed['modal_sha256']==sha(O/'MODAL_CONTRACT.json')
            a.policy.load_state_dict(resumed['state']['model'],strict=True);a.step=resumed['state']['step'];restore_rng(resumed['state']['rng'])
            actual=hashes(Path(c.buffer_dir));expected=resumed['buffer_hashes']
            assert all(actual.get(n)==h for n,h in expected.items())
            if actual!=expected:assert resumed['next_epoch']==100 and not resumed['stage_complete']
            history=json.loads((root/'epochs.json').read_text())
            # Recovery cp is commit authority; preserve uncommitted log tail as evidence.
            keep=[x for x in history if x['task']<resumed['task'] or x['task']==resumed['task'] and x['epoch']<resumed['next_epoch']]
            if history!=keep:write(root/f'interrupted_epochs_{time.time_ns()}.json',history);history=keep
        else:assert not list(Path(c.buffer_dir).glob('*.pt'))
        for t in range(6,10):
            if resumed and (t<resumed['task'] or t==resumed['task'] and resumed['stage_complete']):continue
            start=resumed['next_epoch'] if resumed and t==resumed['task'] else 0
            if start==100:
                store(c,t,b);resumed['stage_complete']=True;resumed['buffer_hashes']=hashes(Path(c.buffer_dir));save(cp,resumed);continue
            info=build_ifa_similarity_matrix(t,c.feature_dir,c.buffer_dir);a.refs,dev=references(c,t)
            write(root/f'ifa_task{t}.json',dict(info=jsonable(info),reference_max_deviation=dev))
            dataset=build_dataset_for_task(c.feature_dir,t,c.buffer_dir,SEED,start=6)
            sampler=DistributedSampler(dataset,num_replicas=1,rank=0,shuffle=True)
            loader=DataLoader(dataset,batch_size=10,num_workers=c.train.num_workers,sampler=sampler,persistent_workers=False)
            a.start_task(-1,loader)
            if resumed and t==resumed['task']:restore(a,resumed['state'])
            for epoch in range(start,100):
                sampler.set_epoch(epoch);a.policy.train();loss=0.;tic=time.time();lr_first=a.optimizer.param_groups[0]['lr']
                for batch in loader:loss+=a.observe(batch,t,epoch,info)
                row=dict(task=t,epoch=epoch,batches=len(loader),steps=a.step,loss=loss/len(loader),
                    lr_first=lr_first,lr_after=a.optimizer.param_groups[0]['lr'],seconds=time.time()-tic)
                history.append(row);write(root/'epochs.json',history)
                if epoch==99:
                    final=root/'models'/f'mlrifa_{t}_model_ep99.pth'
                    save(final,dict(state_dict=cpu(a.policy.state_dict()),cfg=c,task=t,epoch_index=99,
                        modal_sha256=sha(O/'MODAL_CONTRACT.json'),contract_sha256=sha(O/'CONTRACT.json')))
                    if t==6:
                        old=torch.load(Path(os.environ['RA_PARENT'])/'coreset/models/mlrifa_6_model_ep99.pth',map_location='cpu')['state_dict'];now=cpu(a.policy.state_dict())
                        diff={k:float((now[k].double()-old[k].double()).abs().max()) for k in now}
                        same=set(old)==set(now) and all(v==0 for v in diff.values())
                        write(O/'TASK6_TENSOR_PARITY.json',dict(equal=same,max_abs_diff=diff,compared='actual state_dict tensors, no file metadata'))
                        assert same,'Task6 models differ before selection; stop C before task7'
                checkpoint(a,root,t,epoch+1)
                write(O/'RUN_STATUS.json',dict(status='TRAINING',arm=args.arm,task=t,completed_epoch=epoch,optimizer_steps=a.step,updated_unix=time.time(),pid=os.getpid()))
                print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
            store(c,t,b);checkpoint(a,root,t,100,True);resumed=None
        assert len(history)==400 and all(sum(r['task']==t for r in history)==100 for t in range(6,10))
        write(root/'TRAINING_COMPLETE.json',dict(epochs=400,steps=a.step,seconds_this_invocation=time.time()-begin,
            summed_epoch_seconds=sum(x['seconds'] for x in history),checkpoints=hashes(root/'models','*.pth')))
    finally:dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=='__main__':main()

    c=cfg('eval');c.experiment_dir=str(root);control_seed(SEED);b,ds,shape=data_setup(c,True);c.shape_meta=shape
    write(root/'resolved_actual.json',dict(c));torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark=True

                modal_sha256=sha(O/'MODAL_CONTRACT.json'),loaded_downstream_keys=n,

import os,json,time

def js(p):return json.loads(p.read_text())
def matrix(root,arm):

            rows=[json.loads(x) for x in (root/arm/'evaluation'/f'trials_stage{s}_task{t}.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
            assert len(rows)==20 and {r['trial'] for r in rows}==set(range(20))
            assert all(r['seed']==SEED and r['stage']==s and r['task']==t and r['arm']==arm and type(r['success']) is bool for r in rows)
            rates[s,t]=F(sum(r['success'] for r in rows),20)

def main():

    assert all(sha(p)==h for p,h in binding['protected'].items())
    epochs=js(root/'epochs.json');assert len(epochs)==400 and {(r['task'],r['epoch']) for r in epochs}=={(t,e) for t in range(6,10) for e in range(100)}
    assert sum(r['batches'] for r in epochs)==105500 and epochs[-1]['steps']==105500
    assert js(O/'TASK6_TENSOR_PARITY.json')['equal']
    p=BriefPolicy(cfg('ra_coreset'),None).cpu();loaded=[];selections={};ifa={}
    for t in range(6,10):
        cp=root/'models'/f'mlrifa_{t}_model_ep99.pth';raw=torch.load(cp,map_location='cpu')
        assert raw['epoch_index']==99 and raw['task']==t and raw['contract_sha256']==sha(O/'CONTRACT.json') and raw['modal_sha256']==sha(O/'MODAL_CONTRACT.json')
        loaded.append(dict(task=t,sha256=sha(cp),loaded_keys=strict_downstream(p,cp)))

        assert k==[781,740,780,660][t-6] and len(selected)==len({r['destination'] for r in selected})==k
        offline=js(O/'offline_selection'/f'task{t}.json')
        assert report['selected_ids']==offline['selected_ids']
        assert [Path(r['source']).name for r in selected]==report['selected_ids']
        assert report['anchor_ids']==offline['anchor_ids'] and set(report['anchor_ids'])<=set(report['selected_ids'])
        assert report['swap_count']==len(set(report['anchor_ids'])-set(report['original_ids']))

        for r in selected:assert sha(r['source'])==sha(root/'buffer'/r['destination'])==r['sha256']
        selections[str(t)]={k:report[k] for k in ['anchor_count','intersection_with_parent','swap_count','max_before','max_after','mean_before','mean_after','swaps','seconds','demo_full','demo_original','demo_final']}
        current=js(root/f'ifa_task{t}.json');parent=js(P/'coreset'/f'ifa_task{t}.json');ifa[str(t)]=dict(current=current,parent=parent,equal=current==parent)
    assert hashes(root/'buffer')==js(root/'buffer_after_task9.json')['hashes']
    r,new=matrix(O,'ra_coreset');c,old=matrix(P,'coreset');random,_=matrix(P,'random')
    for key,row in new.items():

        assert row['checkpoint_sha256']==loaded[row['stage']-6]['sha256']
    events=Counter()

        for line in f.read_text().splitlines():events[json.loads(line)['event']]+=1

import json,math,time,random,shutil
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import numpy as np
import torch,h5py
from coreset_exp.common import O,SEED,SELECTOR_SEED,write,sha,hashes,rng,restore_rng
from libero.lifelong.algos import mlr
from libero.lifelong.selectors.greedy_kcenter import greedy_kcenter_select,Distance
from .selector_reference import select_anchor_repair

def select(paths,k,population,binding):
    begin=time.monotonic();saved=rng()
    try:
        s0,original=greedy_kcenter_select(paths,k,SELECTOR_SEED,population)
        ordered=sorted(paths,key=lambda p:Path(p).name);ids=[Path(p).name for p in ordered]
        data=[torch.load(p,map_location='cpu') for p in ordered]
        vv=np.array([x['feature'][0,:,1:3,:].numpy() for x in data]);aa=np.array([x['actions'][0,-1,:].numpy() for x in data])
        for p,a in zip(ordered,aa):
            row=binding[Path(p).name];assert sha(p)==row['sha256']
            assert np.array_equal(a,np.asarray(row['last_action'],dtype=np.float32))
        d=Distance(vv,aa,population,SELECTOR_SEED);D=d.distances(np.arange(len(ids)))
        assert d.hs==original['visual_scale'] and d.as_==original['action_distance_scale']
        names,report=select_anchor_repair(ids,[Path(p).name for p in s0],D,seed=SEED)
        idx={n:p for n,p in zip(ids,ordered)}
        report.update(original_selection=original,original_ids=[Path(p).name for p in s0],selected_ids=names,
                      demo_full=dict(Counter(binding[n]['demo_id'] for n in ids)),
                      demo_original=dict(Counter(binding[Path(p).name]['demo_id'] for p in s0)),
                      demo_final=dict(Counter(binding[n]['demo_id'] for n in names)),seconds=time.monotonic()-begin)
        return [idx[n] for n in names],report
    finally:restore_rng(saved)

def store(c,t,benchmark):
    begin=time.monotonic();root=Path(c.run_root);mfile=root/'storage'/f'task{t}.json'
    paths=mlr._list_pt(str(O/'features'/str(t)));k=math.ceil(.5*len(paths))
    if mfile.exists():
        m=json.loads(mfile.read_text());assert m['contract_sha256']==sha(O/'CONTRACT.json') and m['modal_sha256']==sha(O/'MODAL_CONTRACT.json')
    else:
        before=hashes(Path(c.buffer_dir));assert not any(n.startswith(f't{t}__') for n in before)
        assert len(before)+k<=mlr.BUFFER_CAPACITY
        demos=json.loads((O/'FEATURES.json').read_text())['demos'][str(t)]
        with h5py.File(str(Path(c.folder)/benchmark.get_task_demonstration(t))) as f:population=np.concatenate([f['data'][d]['actions'][:] for d in demos])
        binding=json.loads((O/'bindings'/f'task{t}.json').read_text())['windows']
        selected,report=select(paths,k,population,binding)
        preflight=json.loads((O/'selection_preflight'/f'task{t}.json').read_text())
        assert report['original_ids']==preflight['original_ids'] and report['selected_ids']==preflight['selected_ids']
        assert len(set(selected))==len(selected)==k
        m=dict(task=t,K=k,current_count=len(paths),before=before,selected=[dict(source=p,destination=f't{t}__{Path(p).name}',sha256=sha(p)) for p in selected],selection=report,contract_sha256=sha(O/'CONTRACT.json'),modal_sha256=sha(O/'MODAL_CONTRACT.json'))
        write(mfile,m)
    buffer=Path(c.buffer_dir);buffer.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    allowed=dict(m['before']);allowed.update({r['destination']:r['sha256'] for r in m['selected']})
    actual=hashes(buffer);assert set(actual)<=set(allowed) and all(allowed[n]==h for n,h in actual.items())
    for r in m['selected']:
        src=Path(r['source']);dst=buffer/r['destination'];assert sha(src)==r['sha256']
        if dst.exists():assert sha(dst)==r['sha256']
        else:
            tmp=dst.with_suffix('.copying');shutil.copy2(src,tmp);assert sha(tmp)==r['sha256'];tmp.replace(dst)
    after=hashes(buffer);assert after==allowed
    result=dict(counts={str(i):sum(n.startswith(f't{i}__') for n in after) for i in range(6,t+1)},total=len(after),hashes=after,modal_sha256=sha(O/'MODAL_CONTRACT.json'),seconds=time.monotonic()-begin)
    write(root/f'buffer_after_task{t}.json',result);return result
